editions.name: MoOS Desktop
editions.summary: The general desktop image — signed, atomic, and always up to date. Recommended for most machines (Intel / AMD / Nouveau).

editions.name: MoOS Desktop · NVIDIA
editions.summary: Same desktop with the open NVIDIA driver layered in — for machines with a modern NVIDIA GPU.

editions.name: MoOS Cloud
editions.summary: The 24/7 server edition for a cheap VPS: no games or Android layer, SSH-first, browser-reachable desktop. Same signed update train.

iso.notes: The bootable USB ISO is built on request from the published image. Permanent hosting is being finalized — until then, install MoOS from the signed container image with the one command shown on this page.
